28.0 to 28.8 s: station on tall post with solar panel at left, amber rings run down flooded bungalow street to a distant hub, water reflection below, caption half-mile in streets, Illustration Ranges as described disclosure.
29.0 to 29.8 s: rings fade, dashed scale bar draws up the street, amber More than a half-mile tag pins by 29.4 s, hub mast lamp begins to light at 29.8 s, same caption throughout.
30.0 to 30.8 s: scale bar, half-mile tag and lit hub mast lamp held on the flooded street, caption present to 30.6 s and gone at 30.8 s.

31.0 s street held, 31.2 s cut to open green country with fence, tan Hub building with mast, Station inset at upper left with arcs leaving it, caption In open country, up to five miles appears by 31.6 s.
32.0 to 32.8 s: large amber rings grow from the inset, Up to five miles in open country tag pins at 32.2 to 32.4 s, mast lamp glows and hub window lights at 32.6 s.
33.0 to 33.8 s: concentric amber rings keep spreading over the open-country hub, five-mile tag, lit mast lamp and lit window held, caption still shown. I saw no clear colour fringing.
34.0 to 34.8 s: same open-country hub with rings and tag held, caption present to 34.6 s and gone at 34.8 s, no new development in this span.

35.0 and 35.2 s open country held, 35.4 s cut to hub interior: seated responder in navy jacket at desk, Flood path map monitor with blue creek, mug and keyboard, disclosure Not a real hub, caption At the hub, a second, larger AI maps by 35.6 s.
36.0 to 36.8 s: A second, larger model tag pins above the monitor, yellow station dots appear along the creek on the map, responder's hands shift on the keyboard, caption unchanged.
37.0 to 37.8 s: desk composition held, dots on the map and the model tag stay, only small hand movement at the keyboard, caption unchanged.
38.0 s desk, 38.2 s cut to full-frame Flood path map, orange path spreads along the creek from 38.6 s and branches down streets at 38.8 s, caption flood paths for responders appears at 38.8 s.
39.0 to 39.8 s: orange flood paths complete, Higher risk legend and For emergency responders tag pin at 39.6 s, dashed amber zone outlines draw around three low areas.
40.0 to 40.8 s: map held with dashed higher-risk zones and responders tag, caption present to 40.2 s and gone from 40.4 s, so the map holds uncaptioned to 40.8 s.

41.0 s empty cork board over flooded lawn and street, Validation accuracy card pins at 41.2 s with empty bar and Reported by the university, amber ring marker at bar start by 41.8 s, caption The university reports early chip AI validation.
42.0 to 42.8 s: orange tape fills the validation bar left to right behind the ring marker, reaching the bar end by 42.8 s, same caption.
43.0 to 43.8 s: bar full, ring marker fades out, a second blue pushpin appears at the card's upper right at 43.6 s, board and street held, caption present.
44.0 to 44.8 s: card with full bar and two pins held static on the board, caption gone from 44.6 s, no new development in this span.

45.0 to 45.8 s: slightly closer on the card, 98.82% fades in above the bar from 45.4 s and is fully legible at 45.6 s, caption Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent, tag begins to swing in at 45.8 s.
46.0 to 46.8 s: Initial assessments after training tag swings in and settles under the validation card, 98.82% and bar stay, caption unchanged.
47.0 to 47.8 s: a blank Field result card slides in from the right at 47.4 s, settles beside the tag by 47.6 s, a yellow pushpin presses it at 47.8 s, caption unchanged.
48.0 to 48.8 s: validation card, assessments tag and blank Field result card held on the board, caption present to 48.4 s then gone by 48.6 s.

49.0 s board, 49.2 s cut to standing figure in green coat in front of the board holding a rubber stamp, disclosure Not a real report or map, arm lifts the stamp, caption The announcement reports no field result by 49.6 s.
50.0 to 50.8 s: arm swings stamp over the cards, stamp comes down on Field result card and a None reported mark appears by 50.6 s, arm lifts again, caption present.
51.0 to 51.8 s: the arm with the stamp returns to waist height, figure ends standing with both hands low, None reported mark stays on the card, caption present.

52.0 s board, 52.2 s cut to the same figure at a chain-link fence with pipe post, skyline and pond, faint outline appears, paper grid map with blue creek pins to the fence by 52.8 s, caption It names no town with an installed station.
53.0 to 53.8 s: figure raises an arm and points across the paper map, finger tracing along the creek then upward over the grid, caption unchanged.
54.0 to 54.8 s: finger on the map until 54.2 s, dark Announcement names no installation tag pins at the top of the map at 54.4 s, arm returns to her side, caption present to 54.6 s then gone.

55.0 to 55.4 s fence and map held with tag, 55.6 s cut to wide flooded yard: porch rail, technician with plan sheet and case, dashed station outline on a post, live oak and skyline, caption Deployment is still the goal by 55.8 s.
56.0 to 56.8 s: technician holds the plan sheet in front of her torso, amber arc starts at 56.4 s, amber ellipse rings the dashed outline by 56.6 s, Field result None reported tag pins at right.
57.0 to 57.8 s: Deployment goal amber tag pins at 57.0 s, caption shown to 57.2 s and gone by 57.4 s, technician lowers the plan sheet to waist height at 57.6 to 57.8 s.

58.0 to 58.8 s: held composition, technician with the plan tilted at the waist, dashed outline inside amber ellipse, Deployment goal and Field result tags at right, no caption, closed case never opened.

59.0 and 59.2 s same yard tail held, 59.4 s cut to a dim credits card fading in, fully bright by 59.6 s: Texas AI Docket wordmark with Lone Star flag, URL, sources, illustration, map and music credits.

60.0 to 60.8 s: static credits card, The Daily Dispatch header, Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, UT San Antonio Today September 8th, Kevin MacLeod music credit, unchanged across all five samples.
61.0 to 61.8 s: identical static credits card with wordmark, flag, URL, sources, illustration, map and music lines legible, no change across the five samples.
62.0 to 62.8 s: identical static credits card continues unchanged, wordmark, flag, URL and credit lines all legible.
63.0 to 63.8 s: identical static credits card continues unchanged, wordmark, flag, URL and credit lines legible.
64.0, 64.2 and final native frame at 64.367 s: static credits card held through the last frame, same wordmark, flag, URL, sources and music credit.
